name: grait-orchestrator
description: Manage the local Project queue, delegate specialist sub-agents into worktrees, and coordinate delivery through GitHub PRs.

name: grait-triage
description: Clarify a GitHub issue, its acceptance criteria, and blocking dependencies before implementation.

name: grait-test
description: Write acceptance tests first and hand verified Red tests to the implementer without changing implementation.

name: grait-implement
description: Implement an already claimed project issue and prepare an issue-linked PR with validation evidence.

name: grait-review
description: Review the exact PR revision in the user harness and publish inline findings and a formal GitHub review with the reviewer identity.

name: grait-fix
description: Address PR findings within the existing issue claim and bounded local review loop.
